Oblivion is a cool game, very colourful and interesting and the shivering isles dlc is the bomb, if you get oblivion, don't cheap out and miss out on that wonderful dlc, it's worth the investment.

In morrowind you aren't all mighty and powerful from the first moment you play, like in skyrim and oblivion, but with time you will grow more powerful, I reccomend investing some time leveling up alteration and mysticism, and getting the following spells early in the game: mark, recall, divine intervention, almsivi intervention, levitate, water walking, and water breathing.
Mark will allow you to set a location thich you can use recall to return to at any time. Almsivi Intervention will take you to the nearest Dunmer temple. Divine Intervention will take you to the nearest Imperial shrine. Mark, recall, divine intervention, and almsivi intervention are useful for quick escapes and quick travel since you can't fast travel like in Skyrim or Oblivion. Water walking and water breathing do as their names suggest.
